## Define functions
```{r}
bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}

calculate.CI.by.metric = function(data, scenario.name, metric, n = 500){
  bt_resamples <- bootstraps(data %>% filter(scenario_name == scenario.name), times = n)
  
  bt_resamples$mean.metric <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, metric)
  metric_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.metric, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  return(
      data.frame(
      scenario_name = scenario.name, 
      metric = metric,
      metric.mean = mean(bt_resamples$mean.metric),
      metric.lb = metric_95[[1]], 
      metric.ub = metric_95[[2]]
    )
  )
}

format_sig3 <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(val) > 0 & abs(val) < 1) {
      formatC(signif(val, 3), digits=3, format="fg", flag="#")
    } else {
      formatC(round(val), format="d")
    }
  }, character(1))
}
```

## Generate basic metrics tables
```{r}
time.series.metrics.disaggregated <- sim.results %>% 
  mutate(Year = ceiling(Year) - 1) %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year <= 2046, Age >= 25) %>% 
  group_by(Year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population*pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            HIV_SelfTest = sum( HIV_SelfTest * pop_scaling_factor),
            Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * pop_scaling_factor), 
            OnART1_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor), 
            .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = PLHIV - On_ART) 

time.series.metrics.disaggregated %>% write_csv("HIVMC_AI/basic_metrics.csv")

time.series.metrics.disaggregated <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated %>%
  mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(Year - discount_start_year) ) %>%
  mutate(On_ART.discount = On_ART * discount_factor,
         HIV_SelfTest.discount = HIV_SelfTest * discount_factor,
         Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount = Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * discount_factor,
         OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount = OnART1_defaulter_tracer * discount_factor)

data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART), 
            On_ART.discount = sum(On_ART.discount),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART),
            HIV_SelfTest = sum(HIV_SelfTest),
            HIV_SelfTest.discount = sum(HIV_SelfTest.discount),
            Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP),
            Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount = sum(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount),
            OnART1_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_defaulter_tracer),
            OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount = sum(OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount),
            .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 <- data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% merge(
  data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% filter(scenario_name == 'daly.baseline') %>% 
    select(sim.ix, 
           Newly.Infected.baseline = Newly.Infected,
           Died_from_HIV.baseline = Died_from_HIV,
           On_ART.baseline = On_ART, 
           On_ART.discount.baseline = On_ART.discount, 
           Off_ART.baseline = Off_ART),
  by = c("sim.ix")
) %>% 
  mutate(Newly.Infected.diff = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
         Died_from_HIV.diff = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.baseline,
         On_ART.diff = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
         On_ART.discount.diff = On_ART.discount - On_ART.discount.baseline,
         Off_ART.diff = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline) %>% 
  mutate(Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.diff/Newly.Infected.baseline,
         Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.diff/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
         On_ART.pct = On_ART.diff/On_ART, 
         On_ART.discount.pct = On_ART.discount.diff/On_ART.discount, 
         Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.diff/Off_ART)

metric.names = c(
  "Newly.Infected",
  "Died_from_HIV",
  "On_ART",
  "On_ART.discount",
  "Off_ART",
  "Newly.Infected.diff",
  "Died_from_HIV.diff",
  "On_ART.diff",
  "On_ART.discount.diff",
  "Off_ART.diff",
  "Newly.Infected.pct",
  "Died_from_HIV.pct",
  "On_ART.pct",
  "On_ART.discount.pct",
  "Off_ART.pct"
)

scenario.names = c("daly.baseline", "daly.prep", "daly.retention", "daly.self.test")

metrics.data = data.frame()

for (i in metric.names){
  for (j in scenario.names) {
    
    #print(c(i,j))
    h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = j,
      metric = i)
    
    metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)
  }
}

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = "daly.retention",
      metric = "OnART1_defaulter_tracer")
metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = "daly.retention",
      metric = "OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount")
metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = "daly.prep",
      metric = "Initiate_Intervention_PrEP")
metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = "daly.prep",
      metric = "Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount")
metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = "daly.self.test",
      metric = "HIV_SelfTest")
metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045,
      scenario.name = "daly.self.test",
      metric = "HIV_SelfTest.discount")
metrics.data = rbind(metrics.data, h)

metrics.data %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = metric, names_from = scenario_name, values_from = metric.mean)

metrics.data %>%  write_csv("HIVMC_AI/basic_metrics_with_CIs.csv")
```

```{r}
  filter(Year >= 2025.5) %>%

  dplyr::summarise(
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),

   )

         )

m2 <- m2 %>%
        mutate(On_ART_calib = On_ART*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_calib = Infected*pop_scaling_factor,
        Died_from_HIV_calib = Died_from_HIV*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_off_ART_calib = (Infected - On_ART)*pop_scaling_factor)

life_expectancy = 80
m2$Age <- ifelse(m2$Age >life_expectancy, life_expectancy, m2$Age)

m3 <- m2 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
      dplyr::select(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix, 
                    Died_from_HIV_calib, Infected_off_ART_calib, On_ART_calib) %>%
      dplyr::summarise_all(list(median=median))

disability.tibble <- m3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    infected_untreated = sum(Infected_off_ART_calib_median),
    on_art = sum(On_ART_calib_median)
    ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = Year_Integer)

m4 <- m3 %>% mutate(year_applied = Year_Integer - (Age - (life_expectancy + 1)))

daly.tibble <- merge(
  tibble(scenario_name_ = scenario.names),
  tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ),
  all = TRUE
) %>% 
  merge(  tibble(sim.ix = seq(1,250)), all=TRUE)

daly_expanded <- tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ) %>% 
  crossing(
    sim.ix = unique(m4$sim.ix),
    scenario_name = unique(m4$scenario_name)
  )

yll <- daly_expanded %>%
  left_join(m4, by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")) %>%
  filter(Year_Integer <= year, year_applied > year) %>%
  group_by(year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(
    yll = sum(Died_from_HIV_calib_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daly = left_join(
  yll, 
  disability.tibble, 
  by=c("year", "sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>%
 replace(is.na(.), 0)

daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly = infected_untreated*infected_weight + on_art*art_weight + yll)
daly <- daly %>% mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(year - discount_start_year) )
daly[daly$year < discount_start_year,'discount_factor'] <- 1.0
daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly_future_discounted = daly*discount_factor )

# Intermediate table!
HIV.DALYs <- daly %>% select(
  Year = year, 
  scenario_name,
  sim.ix,
  HIV.DALY = daly,
  HIV.DALY.discounted = daly_future_discounted)

HIV.DALYs %>% write_csv("HIVMC_AI/INSPIRE_CE_DALY_calculation.csv")
```

### Generate confidence interval calculations
Aggregate and calculate total DALYs averted
```{r}
HIV.DALYs <- read_csv("HIVMC_AI/INSPIRE_CE_DALY_calculation.csv")

# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 
  
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == 'daly.baseline') %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted
  )

metric.names = c("HIV.DALY", "HIV.DALY.discounted",
                 "HIV.DALY.diff", "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff",
                 "HIV.DALY.pct", "HIV.DALY.discounted.pct")

scenario.names = c("daly.baseline", "daly.prep", "daly.retention", "daly.self.test")

daly.cis = data.frame()

for (i in metric.names){
  for (j in scenario.names) {
    
    #print(c(i,j))
    h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = HIV.DALYs.agg,
      scenario.name = j,
      metric = i)
    
    daly.cis = rbind(daly.cis, h)
  }
}

daly.cis

daly.cis %>% write_csv("HIVMC_AI/DALY_calculation_CIs.csv")

```

```{r}
costs.data <- merge(
  metrics.data %>% pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "scenario_name",
    names_from = "metric",
    values_from = c("metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub"),
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^metric\\.", "", .), starts_with("metric.")),
  daly.cis %>%  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "scenario_name",
    names_from = "metric",
    values_from = c("metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub")
  ) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^metric\\.", "", .), starts_with("metric.")),
  by = c("scenario_name")
)

cost.threshold.calculation <- costs.data %>% 
  select(scenario_name, 
         mean_On_ART.diff, mean_On_ART.discount.diff,
         mean_HIV.DALY.diff, mean_HIV.DALY.discounted.diff,
         mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer, mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount,
         mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP, mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount,
         mean_HIV_SelfTest, mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount) %>% 
  mutate(
    undiscounted.num = - CET * mean_HIV.DALY.diff - ppyOnART * mean_On_ART.diff,
    discounted.num = - CET * mean_HIV.DALY.discounted.diff - ppyOnART * mean_On_ART.discount.diff
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ART.cost = case_when(
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer),
    ART.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount),
    PREP.cost = case_when(
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP),
    PREP.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount),
    self.testing.cost = case_when(
      mean_HIV_SelfTest == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_HIV_SelfTest != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_HIV_SelfTest),
    self.testing.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount)
  )
  
cost.threshold.calculation %>% 
  select(scenario_name, 
         ART.cost, ART.discount.cost,
         PREP.cost, PREP.discount.cost,
         self.testing.cost, self.testing.discount.cost)
```

# Calculate CIs on Upper Bound Cost Thresholds

```{r}
HIV.DALYs <- read_csv("HIVMC_AI/INSPIRE_CE_DALY_calculation.csv")
# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 
  
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == 'daly.baseline') %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted
  )

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging <- merge(
  HIV.DALYs.agg %>% 
    select(sim.ix, scenario_name, HIV.DALY.diff, HIV.DALY.discounted.diff),
  data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% 
    select(sim.ix, scenario_name, 
           On_ART.diff, On_ART.discount.diff,
           HIV_SelfTest, HIV_SelfTest.discount,
           Initiate_Intervention_PrEP, Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount,
           ART = OnART1_defaulter_tracer,
           ART.discount = OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount),
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>% merge(
    data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% 
    select(scenario_name, sim.ix, 
           ART.maintenance = On_ART,
           ART.maintenance.discount = On_ART.discount),
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
) %>% 
  mutate(
    undiscounted.num = - CET * HIV.DALY.diff - ppyOnART * On_ART.diff,
    discounted.num = - CET * HIV.DALY.discounted.diff - ppyOnART * On_ART.discount.diff
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ART.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART),
    ART.discount.cost = case_when(
      ART.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      ART.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/ART.discount),
    ART.maintenance.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART.maintenance),
    ART.maintenance.discount.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART.maintenance.discount),
    PREP.cost = case_when(
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP == 0 ~ 0,
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/Initiate_Intervention_PrEP),
    PREP.discount.cost = case_when(
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount),
    Self.testing.cost = case_when(
      HIV_SelfTest == 0 ~ 0,
      HIV_SelfTest != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/HIV_SelfTest),
    Self.testing.discount.cost = case_when(
      HIV_SelfTest.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      HIV_SelfTest.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/HIV_SelfTest.discount)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ARTcosts_fraction = ppyOnART * On_ART.diff/undiscounted.num,
    ARTcosts_fraction.discount = ppyOnART * On_ART.discount.diff/ discounted.num)

#cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs <- data.frame()

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "daly.retention",
      metric = "ART.cost")
cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(

      metric = "ART.maintenance.discount.cost")
cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(

      scenario.name = "daly.retention",

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(

      scenario.name = "daly.retention",
      metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount")
cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
```
